releaseNotes:
## 2.0.0-beta.30 - 2026-09-04

- Adds durable sandbox lifecycle governance across local and Cube providers:
  warm workspaces are paused after inactivity, retired after the retention
  window or capacity pressure, and restored from the durable workspace on the
  next Run without losing conversation history
- Reconciles AgentOS-owned orphan, duplicate, incompatible, and failed-cleanup
  sandbox resources through one restart-safe lifecycle journal instead of
  leaving historical conversations pinned to stale physical sandboxes
- Makes Sandbox provider and Runtime-generation changes drain active Runs,
  rebind durable Sessions, clear incompatible Harness continuation state, and
  recover deterministically after an interrupted Core restart
- Adds fair, configurable admission control for global execution, sandbox
  preparation, Codex-per-sandbox, and OpenCode-per-sandbox concurrency, with
  durable settings and live queue counters in system settings
- Exposes `queued`, `environment_preparing`, and `execution_start` as distinct
  SDK and playground phases so clients can separate capacity waits, sandbox
  startup, and model execution without counting preparation as response time
- Serializes template materialization, persists Cube template and build IDs as
  soon as a build is accepted, and resumes the same build after refresh or
  restart instead of creating parallel templates
- Keeps conversation execution state scoped to the displayed Session across
  refresh and navigation, preventing a background conversation from replacing
  another conversation's queue, preparation, timer, or stop state
- Refreshes the settings experience with visual system/light/dark theme cards,
  consistent surfaces and interaction depth, clearer advanced capacity
  settings, and an input-replacing template preparation state
- Updates the TypeScript and Java SDK event vocabulary with
  `environment_preparing` while retaining forward-compatible event parsing
- Ships with AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.13`, containing the matching local
  sandbox inventory protocol used by lifecycle reconciliation

### Verification

- Passed the complete production build and all 407 TypeScript, Server, UI,
  Harness, Runtime, and TypeScript SDK tests
- Passed all AgentOS Sandbox VMM Go tests and all 10 Java SDK tests
- Passed 117 focused lifecycle, capacity, migration, template, provider, SDK,
  and UI regression tests
- Completed real Cube-backed browser conversations with both Codex and
  OpenCode; observed completed response durations of 4.291 seconds and 7.697
  seconds respectively, with no browser warnings or errors
